title: Canonical condensed coefficient comparison and shift data
statement: Use the universe convention [def-weil-size-convention]. Fix a prime $\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-numbers], the chosen algebraic closure $\Omega$ [def-weil-algebraic-closure], a scheme $T$ [def-pc-scheme], and finite intermediate fields $E\subseteq F\subseteq G$ [def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set]. Use the internal module categories over the condensed coefficient rings of [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category] and their unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Write $T_{E,F}$ for total left-derived extension of scalars. The canonical derived multiplication comparison $T_{F,G}\circ T_{E,F}\cong T_{E,G}$ is obtained by the exact-functor derived-composition comparison followed by derivation of the ordinary scalar-extension associativity isomorphism induced by $c\otimes(b\otimes p)\mapsto cb\otimes p$ and the equality of the composite coefficient inclusion with the direct inclusion. The unit $T_{E,E}\cong\mathrm{id}$ is obtained by deriving the tensor unit $a\otimes p\mapsto ap$ and identifying the derived identity with the identity. Equip finite-stage scalar extension, and extension to $\Omega$, with the coherent shift structures transported from their exact termwise derived functors along the canonical total-left-derived-functor comparison. The comparison for $G=\Omega$ is the existing derivedExtendScalarsCompIso. These are data constructions, not coherence assertions.

proof.text: For condensedCoefficientMap_comp, unfold the coefficient inclusions via their abbreviations and rewrite by coefficientMap_comp and Profinite.padicSubfieldRingObjMap_comp. For condensedCoefficientMap_id, rewrite by Profinite.padicSubfieldRingObjMap_id and coefficientMap_id. These are applications of the existing functoriality identities, valid also for equal coefficient fields.

For condensedCoefficientCompositeExact, use the preceding equality of coefficient maps to form Mod.extendScalarsIsoOfEq. Apply preservesFiniteLimits_of_natIso to its inverse, with the existing CondensedRing.preservesFiniteLimits_extendScalars_padicSubfieldRingObjMap instance on the direct inclusion. This is only a transport of that upstream instance, whose proof obligation remains open; it does not prove finite-field flatness anew.

Keep the existing data constructions: condensedCoefficientCompIso is the inverse exact-functor derived-composition comparison followed by derivation of Mod.extendScalarsComp and transport along the coefficient-map equality. The unit derives Mod.extendScalarsId after identity transport and identifies the derived identity. Both shift structures are transported from the exact termwise derived functors along leftDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory. No new existence witness or comparison data is chosen.
